searchText: Does external transaction into delegated account also follows delegation and executes the code? EIP only mentions instructions I guess so, otherwise every transfer would just fail And another nitpick: > 4. Verify the nonce of authority is equal to nonce. I assume this includes checking that nonce = 0 for authority that doesn't exist yet. Better also to explicitly clarify in spec.
